blends.desc:
Intrusion Blend.

Blending: 4 X BB Rumble Chain Season 1 NFT and 2 X Moon Chip NFT
Result: Intrusion NFT.

This NFT will be useable in our upcoming CrewToons Dungeon with Epic Mining Power and is limited to 50 mints only.

Remember to keep 1 BB Rumble Chain Season 1 NFT in your wallet for your all important Discord role!!

Get BB Rumble Chain Season 1 NFT's here: https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/wax-mainnet/bigbanggames/659443

Get your Moon Chips here: https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/wax-mainnet/crewtoonswax/328698

**You can also obtain a Moon chip by blending 4 Earth chips here: https://neftyblocks.com/c/crewtoonswax/blends/blend.nefty/6731**

Get your Earth Chips here: https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/wax-mainnet/crewtoonswax/328023

**Good Luck and Have Fun in the Rumbles Fam**Blend.
